import sys
import math

PREC = 1e-10

def distance(a, b):
    return math.sqrt(distance2(a, b))

def distance2(a, b):
    dx = a.x - b.x
    dy = a.y - b.y
    return dx * dx + dy * dy

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"({self.x},{self.y})"

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return abs(self.x - other.x) < PREC and abs(self.y - other.y) < PREC

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash((round(self.x, 10), round(self.y, 10)))

    def sub(self, other):
        return Point(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)

    def add(self, other):
        return Point(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)

    def mul(self, f):
        return Point(self.x * f, self.y * f)

    def div(self, f):
        return Point(self.x / f, self.y / f)

    def normalize(self):
        length = math.sqrt(self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y)
        return self.div(length)

    def getAlpha(self):
        return Point(-self.y, self.x)

    def moveAlongLine(self, line, length):
        return self.moveAlongVector(line.asVector(), length)

    def moveAlongVector(self, vec, length):
        return self.add(vec.normalize().mul(length))

class Line:
    def __init__(self, from_, to):
        self.from_ = from_
        self.to = to

    def asVector(self):
        return self.to.sub(self.from_)

    def length(self):
        return distance(self.from_, self.to)

class Circle:
    def __init__(self, x, y, r):
        self.center = Point(x, y)
        self.r = r

    @staticmethod
    def isIntersect(a, b):
        d = distance(a.center, b.center)
        return d <= a.r + b.r + PREC and d + PREC >= abs(a.r - b.r)

    @staticmethod
    def isIntersect2(a, b):
        d = distance(a.center, b.center)
        return d < a.r + b.r and d > abs(a.r - b.r)

    @staticmethod
    def intersectAt(a, b, point_set):
        if not Circle.isIntersect(a, b):
            return
        line = Line(a.center, b.center)
        d = distance(a.center, b.center)
        middleDistance = (d * d - b.r * b.r + a.r * a.r) / (2 * d)
        middle = a.center.moveAlongLine(line, middleDistance)
        alpha = line.asVector().getAlpha()
        height = math.sqrt(a.r * a.r - middleDistance * middleDistance)
        first = middle.moveAlongVector(alpha, height)
        second = middle.moveAlongVector(alpha, -height)
        point_set.add(first)
        if not second.__eq__(first):
            point_set.add(second)

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    circles = []
    for _ in range(n):
        x = int(next(it))
        y = int(next(it))
        r = int(next(it))
        circles.append(Circle(x, y, r))

    if n == 3 and not Circle.isIntersect(circles[0], circles[1]):
        total = 4
        if Circle.isIntersect2(circles[0], circles[2]):
            total += 1
        if Circle.isIntersect2(circles[1], circles[2]):
            total += 1
        print(total)
        return

    total = 1
    for i in range(n):
        total += 1
        point_set = set()
        for j in range(i):
            Circle.intersectAt(circles[i], circles[j], point_set)
        if len(point_set) >= 2:
            total += len(point_set) - 1
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
